text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto, having triumphed over T.M. 
Opera O in six G1 races, including the 
Satsuki Sho and the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, something feels off. I've won far 
too much. Could this be a dream where I 
somehow switched places with the Overlord?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if to back that up, the other Umamusume 
showered Meisho Doto with excessive 
praise, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is definitely no dream. Yes, this is 
talent bearing fruit—an undeniable, 
alternate true history.
